title.help: Short project title, e.g. 'Data lake SOW'.

customer_name.help: Use the customer placeholder exactly as it appears in the notes.

project_name.help: Name of the customer's project or system, as used in the notes.

current_environment.help: Where the project runs today, e.g. 'on-premises' or a platform name.

methodology.help: A short paragraph: how the work is organised (phases, reviews, approvals).

source_system.help: The data source(s) to extract from.

storage_target.help: Where the raw and processed data is stored.

processing_service.help: The service or tool that processes the data.

catalog_name.help: The data catalog or governance service.

query_service.help: The service used to query the data.

processing_schedule.help: How often processing runs, e.g. 'once a day'.

change_response_days.help: Business days to respond to a change request, e.g. '5'. 'To be confirmed' if not stated.

hypercare_weeks.help: Hyper-Care period, e.g. '2 weeks'. 'To be confirmed' if not stated.

support_weeks.help: Support period, e.g. '4 weeks'. 'To be confirmed' if not stated.

architecture_note.help: One sentence describing the architecture diagram that is added by hand in Word.

extraction_plan.help: One item per extraction: what, from where, to where, with which service, how often.

extraction_dod.help: Use cases with their definition of done for the extraction tests.

processing_dod.help: Use cases with their definition of done for the processing tests.

consumer_dod.help: Use cases with their definition of done for the data consumer tests.

volume_assumptions.help: Assumptions about current and expected data volume. 'To be confirmed' if not stated.

assumptions.help: Other assumptions, because the notes were silent or unclear.

deliverables.help: Deliverables with their definition of done.

milestone_share.help: Milestones in order with their share of the total project, e.g. '15%'. 'To be confirmed' if not stated.

effort.help: Roles with estimated hours. 'To be confirmed' if not stated.

data_env_costs.help: One row per AWS service of the data environment. Only costs stated in the notes, otherwise 'To be confirmed'.

data_env_total.help: Total of the data environment costs, only if every row has a figure. Otherwise 'To be confirmed'.

shared_env_costs.help: One row per AWS service of the shared environment. Only costs stated in the notes, otherwise 'To be confirmed'.

shared_env_total.help: Total of the shared environment costs, only if every row has a figure. Otherwise 'To be confirmed'.

cost_summary.help: Data environment, shared environments and support, one row each.

cost_total.help: Total monthly cost, only if all figures are known. Otherwise 'To be confirmed'.

open_questions.help: impact is one of: price, scope, schedule, design, risk.

forbidden_patterns.name: resource count such as '2 x EC2'
